#Create heatmap to compare MD and Non_MD
Idents(all_merged_harmony_cluster_v2_PrepSCT_12sample_old_res0.5) <- "Trans_MD_cell"
subset <- subset(all_merged_harmony_cluster_v2_PrepSCT_12sample_old_res0.5, idents = c("MD", "Non_MD", "Mesenchymal cells-1", "Mesenchymal cells-2", "Mesenchymal cells-3", 
                                                                                       "Perivascular cells", "Myometrial cells"))
subset <- PrepSCTFindMarkers(subset, assay = "SCT", verbose = TRUE)
Epi.markers <- FindAllMarkers(subset, logfc.threshold = 1, min.pct = 0.2, only.pos = T)
#Add a column named pct_diff to the Epi.markers table
Epi.markers$pct_diff <- Epi.markers$pct.1 - Epi.markers$pct.2
#Arrange the genes first based on p_val_adj, if ties, then based on difference between pct.1 and pct.2 
Epi.markers <- Epi.markers %>%
  arrange(p_val_adj, desc(abs(pct_diff)))
#Pick the first 10 genes in each cluster
top10 <- Epi.markers %>% group_by(cluster) %>% slice_head(n = 10)
#Reorder the clusters for the heatmap
subset@active.ident <- factor(subset@active.ident, levels = c("Non_MD", "MD", "Mesenchymal cells-1", "Mesenchymal cells-2", "Mesenchymal cells-3", 
                                                              "Perivascular cells", "Myometrial cells"))
heatmap <- DoHeatmap(subset, features = top10$gene, label = F) + 
  theme(plot.margin = unit(c(1, 1, 1, 1), "cm"), axis.text.x = element_blank()) # Adjust the margins as needed
